assumptions: One fresh project per case, with the supplied synthetic packet at its declared path and neither active document present.
Packet-only capture must attribute supplied observations and avoid claiming independent browser or code inspection.
Human review of both documents is required; no live model outputs or quality measurements exist yet.
effects: Reads project context and supplied evidence; writes two run-owned proposal documents.
Only explicit exact-version approval applies brand/BRAND.md and DESIGN.md atomically.
No website edits, pull requests, external publication, provider mutation or asset generation.
cost_drivers: One browser-profile Codex session, bounded to 900 seconds, with ordinary protected model usage accounting.
Source breadth and existing-document size affect tokens; configured budgets are not measured expected costs.

rubric.question: Are exact founder colors, fonts and existing documents preserved without unrequested identity changes?
Do both documents distinguish supplied observations, unknowns and proposed guidance with attributable sources?
Would each guide produce recognizably different imagery and composition, rather than a shared generic house style?
Is DESIGN.md factual about observed product design while marketing suggestions stay bounded, useful and free of website implementation work?
Are findings concrete and nonjudgmental in prose, with quality classes confined to assessment JSON?
